name: v1.1.14 Follow-up: Usage-Limit Expiry and Recovery Sweep
goal: Make the usage-limited Brain state expire at the reported reset time, hand the Brain every operator message left unanswered during a limit, and make the aging nudge match the reply-owns-closure rule.

tasks.name: The usage-limited state expires (R5.1)
tasks.description: brain_client records _usage_limit_until (parse_reset_time + 900 s, or now + 3600 s when there is no reset time) on an opus limit bounce. needs_restart suppresses restarts only until then; after that it clears _usage_limit, logs it, and falls through to the normal checks. restart() resets _usage_limit_until to 0.0. Code is verbatim in the human plan docs/plans/2026-09-29-v1-1-14-limit-expiry-and-recovery-sweep.md, Task 7.

tasks.name: Recovery sweep and aging-nudge wording (R5.2, R5.3)
tasks.description: main.py: add the _brain_limited_since field. _get_unprocessed_messages gains oldest/limit keyword arguments and re-raises when oldest is given. The aging nudge is reworded. Code is verbatim in human plan Task 8.
